say:1:1033319001:1.text: I know! That's the best news in the whole forest!
say:1:1033319001:1.source_cn: 我知道，这是丛林里最好的消息了！
say:1:1033319001:1.male: I know! That's the best news in the whole forest!
say:1:1033319001:1.female: I know! That's the best news in the whole forest!

say:2:1033319002:1.text: I've gotta rustle up some medicine immediately. Many people have been sick and waiting for some.
say:2:1033319002:1.source_cn: 我得赶紧赶制一批药水出来，之前有不少人生了病，都等着药呢。
say:2:1033319002:1.male: I've gotta rustle up some medicine immediately. Many people have been sick and waiting for some.
say:2:1033319002:1.female: I've gotta rustle up some medicine immediately. Many people have been sick and waiting for some.

say:3:1033319003:1.text: Let me treat you properly when I have some spare time.
say:3:1033319003:1.source_cn: 等我闲下来了，再好好招待你吧。
say:3:1033319003:1.male: Let me treat you properly when I have some spare time.
say:3:1033319003:1.female: Let me treat you properly when I have some spare time.
